1.title: Darline Graham wins primary to contest late brother's US Senate seat
1.summary: The Trump-backed candidate, whose brother Lindsey Graham died in July, has never previously run for elected office.

2.title: Even as Trump’s Standing Slips, He Slingshots Darline Graham to Victory
2.summary: After facing low approval ratings and endorsement setbacks, the president made a show of force in lifting Darline Graham to the Republican nomination for Senate in South Carolina.

3.title: Their Children Want to Play Football. Parents Ask: Is It Worth the Risk?
3.summary: Many families are engaged in tense debates after a new study found a high percentage of N.F.L. players had developed degenerative brain disease.

4.title: Seventeen dead and hundreds unaccounted for as flash flood hits Nepal-Tibet border
4.summary: The flood in Rasuwa - an area north of Kathmandu bordering Tibet - is feared to have swept away villages.

5.title: Far-right Israeli lawmaker damages Palestinian memorial with sledgehammer
5.summary: Zvi Sukkot's actions have drawn widespread condemnation, including from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

6.title: Libyan who was cleared after Lockerbie bombing trial dies aged 70
6.summary: A Facebook post by Libyan Airlines announced the death of Al Amin Khalifah Fhimah and expressed the company's condolences to his family.
